title: 🧠: I'm still young, I have time…
description:
Once you start doing whatever it is you keep putting off… you'll wish you started sooner.

"I'll start tomorrow" turns into next week, then next month, then next year. Time keeps going. Somehow there's more time spent making excuses than actually putting in the work.

What's holding you back? You won't get today back. Start now.

#motivation #climbing #bouldering #discipline #startnow
